text.tspan: A grand terminal for departures through time
Inspection concourse plan / lower and upper platforms shown in context / proposal
GRAND CENTRAL VOLUME / CITY AT THE TOWER CROWN
OPEN TO LOWER DEPARTURE FLOOR −6 m
01 THE PLAYER HAS A PRIVATE BOOTH
One straight-facing desk. The right return and
rear service zone conceal all neighbouring work.
There is no visible row of clerks.
Four numbered departure platforms in this study.
Each has a holding area, boarding gate and teleporter.
The platform count is a proposal, not fixed canon.
Inspection concourse: 0 m, existing desk floor datum.
Lower platforms: −6 m. Upper platforms: +6 m.
A high crossing and supported galleries reveal depth.
Tower lifts → luggage / waiting → desk clearance.
Then the controlled platform stair or lift.
Department routes continue through the right core.
05 THE LEFT VIEW IS THE CITY
A clear side bay faces the tower’s west glazing.
Pan left from the same booth; no coworkers enter view.
The whole pan still needs a 3D occlusion check.
P = one painting. A / B = world artifacts.
Keep the terminal’s scale and circulation dominant.
Neglect belongs to fixtures, displays and repairs.
Levels and routes are architectural proposals. Current Unity scene, PC, original floor assets and gameplay remain untouched.
